title: The most magical way to end TIFF. 🥹 From Making Waves with Hudson Wil...
transcript: Today is the day. It's Hudson Williams Talk Day, Yaga premiere day, and somehow my final day at TIFF. I'm so sad to leave, but what a final day it was. I remember months ago when it was announced that Yaga was going to be premiering at TIFF. I swore I would find a way there. And thanks to TikTok, here I am in Toronto, starting the day off with making waves with Hudson Williams, which was part of TIFF's New Wave Conversation series. I was worried it was going to be chaos, so I headed over to the theater kind of early, and it ended up being really fun because I just kept running into people. Everyone was handing out bracelets and stickers. The best kind of fandom joy. And then suddenly, Hudson Williams was taking the stage. I was up in the balcony, so it was high up, but honestly, a fantastic view. Hudson, those shoes. And I was so thrilled to be in the room. And the conversation was everything. It was a full 90 minute. Very thoughtful, deep about his views on film and acting. He talked about his creative process, and we even watched a clip from a short film that he did. It was very funny. And of course, the heated rivalry of it all. He told a lot of good stories. He also talked about Yaga and apparatus and what a completely wild year he's had. I was absolutely charmed by the entire Thing. Jacob Turner really found a true gem. From there, I was a riding high. I headed over to the Light Box, where I met my friend to grab some dinner, and then it was time for the final event of my entire TIFF experience, the premiere of Yaga. I saw Kat Sandler's original play back in 2019. I loved it so much. Crave gave us little Yaga friendship bracelets, but I literally could not believe I was about to watch the first two episodes with an entire audience of people and the cast for the very first time. I was sad to say goodbye to my face on the TIFF screen. It was so fun getting to watch this in a theater. It's just so weird and vibey, and Cat Sandler is brilliant. I cannot wait for everyone to be talking about this show. The first two episodes drop October 23rd on crave and AMC plus, and then I'll be week by week from there. After the screening, there was a really great talk back with Pat and Hudson and Noah and Clark and Carrie Ann. It was a really perfect conversation. A great way to end TIFF. But it wasn't quite over yet, because first we got to celebrate the show at a little after party. It was actually a really cool bar. There were custom cocktails with drinks that, like, lit up and smoke, and there was a tarot reader and, of course, an incredible collection of wild Creatives I adore. I stayed too long yapping because I had to get back and pack because I had a 7:00am flight back to New York. I genuinely do not have the words to sum up how incredible this week was. So much TIFF content to come. But thank you, TikTok, for bringing me. Thank you, Michael, for hosting my extension. Thank you, Toronto, for being the best. And that's a wrap on the daily vlogs. Thank you, thank you, thank you.
classificationReason: Vlog content about attending TIFF film festival — covering a Hudson Williams talk and the YAGA TV premiere. Entirely film/television festival content, not a stage theater production.
